scope_statement: Bind recorded test and converter input bytes to the explicit final source Git tree. This proof does not assert that all 810 engine-observer paths are unchanged, does not rerun the engine suite, and does not infer a fresh full-repository test run.
hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of exact file bytes; Git blob IDs and modes independently obtained from git ls-tree and git cat-file

incoming_editor_integration.scope: Editor canvas cache and its roadmap only; engine/test/converter sources did not change in this merge.

engine_checkpoint_vs_actual_run_snapshot.explanation: The run checkpoint is a label, not a substitute for exact input snapshots. The observed odt_reader_styles_test.dart correction already existed during the 1913-pass run and matches the final tree.

incidental_observer_exception.why_captured: run_zotero_qualification.py snapshot(tests) unconditionally hashes editor/lib and editor/example/lib for every scope, including the pure Dart engine scope.

engine_dependency_evidence.method: Source-level scan of every engine/legacy library, all 81 engine test entrypoints, and both converter tools for import/export/part URI directives, plus package manifests. Not a compiler-emitted dependency trace.
engine_dependency_evidence.conclusion: The editor canvas is an incidental observed source, not a compiled engine or converter dependency; final editor and Studio reruns bind that changed source independently.

runtime_package_configuration.interpretation: Exact runtime input outside Git; compared by SHA-256 to each recorded before/after snapshot, never represented as a Git blob.
